kpis.description: Key indicator of platform activity and transaction volume. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the last 4 years.

kpis.description: Key indicator of financial performance and revenue diversification

risks.title: Macroeconomic fluctuations and pressure on discretionary spending
risks.score_rationale: Economic fluctuations, including inflation, interest rates, and pressure on discretionary consumer spending, directly impact demand on the platform. The dynamic macroeconomic environment contributed to the 5.3% decline in GMS in 2025.

risks.title: Operational challenges and service disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Operational challenges, such as service outages or quality issues, can harm the company's reputation and affect its ability to attract and retain buyers and sellers.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and user data protection
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity threats and data protection breaches can have a significant impact on the company's reputation and financial results, particularly due to the sensitivity of users' financial and personal data.

risks.title: Intense competition in e-commerce and resale markets
risks.score_rationale: Intense competition in the e-commerce and resale marketplace sector could affect the company's ability to attract and retain buyers and sellers, especially against broader platforms such as Amazon and eBay.

risks.title: Platform reputation and trust
risks.score_rationale: Reputation and trust are crucial for the success of a two-sided marketplace platform. Product quality issues, seller-buyer disputes, or scandals could severely affect the platform's appeal.

risks.title: Dependence on creative seller base
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its active seller base (8.76 million in 2025) to offer creative and unique goods. Significant seller attrition or reduced engagement could affect the platform's viability.

risks.title: Regulatory changes and international trade barriers
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulation, including tariffs, de minimis exemptions, and barriers to international trade, create considerable uncertainty. These factors can directly affect the viability of cross-border commerce on the platform.
